title: Local total-cohomology transport for an arbitrary sheaf comparison
statement: For any f:X→Y, y∈Y, F an O_X-module and p≥0, set c:Spec(O_y)→Y, X′=Spec(O_y)×_Y X, f′ the first projection and F′ the tensor pullback of F. For any O_Y-module G and any isomorphism beta:c*G→R^p f′_*F′, there exists an O_y-linear equivalence e:G_y→H^p(X′,F′) with scalars through Gamma-Spec and f′.appTop. For every I,K,V containing y, every FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices D, every class xi on W=g′^{-1}(f^{-1}V) and every section s of G(V), if the adjoint of beta sends s to D.targetClass p xi, then restriction to W of e(germ(s)) is xi. No properness, coherence or Noetherian condition is imposed. No action of beta on source cohomology classes is asserted. [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-resolution-construction] [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices] [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] [pqf-def-cohomology]

proof.text: Use localPullback_adjoint_stalk_isIso with H=R^p f′_*F′ to prove that the adjoint a:G→c_*H induces an isomorphism on the stalk at y.
Take the A-linear equivalence (c_*H)_y→H^p(X′,F′) with its section-class normalization from localDirectImage_stalk_cohomology and compose with the linear equivalence of the stalk map of a.

Stalk-map naturality sends germ(s) to germ(a_V(s)). Substitute the assumed equality a_V(s)=D.targetClass p xi and apply the section-class normalization of the second equivalence. These equalities are written explicitly in Lean before applying the cohomology restriction.

theorem localDerived_stalk_transport {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y)
    (F : X.Modules) (p : ℕ) (G : Y.Modules)
    (beta : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).obj G ⟶
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).rightDerived p).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F))
    [IsIso beta] :
    ∃ e : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Y.toRingedSpace y).obj G ≃ₗ[Y.presheaf.stalk y]
      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f).toRingedSpace p ⋙
        ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv ≫
            (pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f).appTop).hom).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F),
      ∀ (I : InjectiveResolution F)
        (K : InjectiveResolution
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F))
        (V : Y.Opens) (hy : y ∈ V)
        (D : Scheme.Modules.FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f (Y.fromSpecStalk y) F I K V)
        (xi : (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology
            ((pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
              ((pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F))))
        (s : G.presheaf.obj (op V)),
        Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
          ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
            (Y.fromSpecStalk y))).homEquiv _ _ beta) V s = D.targetClass p xi →
        Scheme.Modules.moduleCohomologyFMap
          ((pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction
            ((pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι).unit.app
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F)) p
          (e.toLinearMap (TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.presheaf V y hy s)) = xi
